output.summary: The 30% decline matches the peer median of -29%, so it is not unusual for the region. Programming does not explain it. Concerts with and without long post-1945 works sold about the same at Brightwater. Committed attendees renew at a steady 85%, so the core audience is not defecting. The distinctive damage came from the relocation. Single-ticket sales fell 45% against a peer median of -9%, and low-usage subscribers doubled as a share and renewed less. Downtown cathedral concerts outsold Brightwater by about 50%, and travel and safety top the exit survey. Marketing is untested. Do not use the decline to justify non-renewal. Present a segmented analysis, separate the artistic review, and use the cathedral dates and a shuttle.
